limitation: Synthetic scripted interactions using Chromium Event Timing entries with a 16ms duration threshold, grouped by interactionId and summarized by each visit maximum. Entries below 16ms are omitted; this is a traceable lab estimate for controlled comparison, not field INP, a complete population measure, or an SLA. First-rAF values are retained only as a separate proxy and are not paint or INP.
